title: Point by Point
style: Fast reggae dance with a syncopated dembow pulse, rapid skank guitar, tight kick and tom drive, and orchestral swells answering the groove; verse stays tense and percussive, pre-chorus strips to bass and clipped vocal lines, chorus opens with strings, choir-like female background vocals, and chant hooks. Lead vocal is close-mic and urgent with double-tracked choruses, breathy ad-libs, risers into each drop, and bright punchy mix with cinematic width., orchestral, reggae
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Grip on the paddle, hand gone cold
Sweat on my brow, but I hold that roll
One point, one breath, one swing, one chance
Heartbeat knocking like a bare drum dance
I see the court like a tightrope line
Pick the right shot at the right damn time

[Pre-Chorus]
Forward, back
Pick, then react
Soft hands, hard truth
No room to slack
If I rush, I pay
If I wait, I stay

[Chorus]
Point by point
I stay alive
Point by point
I fight to survive
One shot now
Then the next one after
(One shot now)
Then the next one after

[Verse 2]
Dink to the kitchen, then I reset low
Eyes on the angle, make the ball go slow
Crosscourt answer, then I split my feet
Every little touch got the whole game beat
Pressure in my chest when the score runs tight
Still I choose clean form in the fire of night
One wrong rush and the moment breaks
One calm choice and the whole side shakes

[Pre-Chorus]
Forward, back
Pick, then react
Soft hands, hard truth
No room to slack
If I chase, I crack
If I trust, I stack

[Chorus]
Point by point
I stay alive
Point by point
I fight to survive
One shot now
Then the next one after
(One shot now)
Then the next one after

[Bridge]
The end won't say
How I got through
The sweat, the fear
The split-second truth
It won't show the hands
Or the pulse in my throat
Just the score on the board
And the final note

[Chorus]
Point by point
I stay alive
Point by point
I fight to survive
One shot now
Then the next one after
(One shot now)
Then the next one after
